summary: Discusses various types of water and their medicinal properties

sections.title: Water Section Chapter One
sections.originalText: 天水为一，地水为二，人之水为三。水为万物之源，水为百药之长。
sections.translation: Heavenly water is one, earthly water is two, human water is three. Water is the source of all things, water is the chief of all medicines.
sections.interpretation: This chapter establishes the fundamental importance of water in both nature and medicine, reflecting the holistic view of Chinese pharmacology.

keyConcepts.description: Medicinal substances derived from water sources
